overview: This file consists of a single Department of State “List of Papers” sheet for material concerning expositions and exhibitions in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It records a report sent from Dairen to the American Embassy by Vincent on August 22, 1933, describing the Grand Manchurian Exposition held at Dairen from July 23 through August 31, 1933, including its exhibits and buildings; the underlying report itself is not present in the supplied text.

people.name: John Carter Vincent
people.role: U.S. Foreign Service officer at Dairen; apparent author of the listed report to the American Embassy

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning the Grand Manchurian Exposition at Dairen
subfiles.about: An index sheet records an August 22, 1933 report from Vincent at Dairen concerning the Grand Manchurian Exposition.
subfiles.summary: The sheet identifies one report sent from Dairen to the American Embassy and routed to the Department’s Far Eastern division. Dated August 22, 1933, the listed report gives an account of the Grand Manchurian Exposition at Dairen, held from July 23 to August 31, 1933. Its contents included descriptions of the exhibits, buildings, and related features, but the report itself is absent from the supplied file text.

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as evidence for a now-absent consular or diplomatic report on a major exposition in Japanese-controlled Dairen. It supplies the report’s date, authorial attribution, routing, event dates, and general contents, making it a valuable archival pointer even without the underlying document. The reference also suggests how exhibitions were documented as part of State Department reporting on industrial affairs in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
